name: Kenikari
source:
Lare is just a normal 15 year-old that wanted to learn some french. Unfortunately, she gets kidnapped and thrown into an unknown facility with other people from different ages, nationalities, and social statuses, all strangers.

If she wants to make it out alive, she'll have to play a death game with lethal puzzles and much more, all run by a masked stranger that talks to them through a screen.

Will she survive? Or will she meet a gruesome fate? What about the others, will they make it out as well? Only time will tell.
